themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders across Europe and the Americas are confronting legal battles and political setbacks, from embezzlement convictions to internal party conflicts. These challenges are reshaping their public image and campaign strategies, with leaders like Marine Le Pen and Nigel Farage leveraging legal outcomes to rally their bases.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's conviction for embezzlement and her subsequent appeal dominate political discourse, with her candidacy for the 2027 presidential election sparking debates about judicial interference in politics.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage resigns as MP to trigger a by-election amid investigations into undeclared donations, framing it as a fight against the establishment.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox faces internal tensions and legal scrutiny, including investigations into its press chief for alleged incompatibility with public office roles.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni navigates legal and political pressures, including tensions with Trump and internal party disputes over electoral strategies.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government faces corruption allegations involving former officials, impacting public trust and political stability.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS confronts internal divisions and legal scrutiny over hospital management and alleged misuse of public funds.

signals: strategic use of legal outcomes for political gain

themes.title: Milei’s ‘shutdown’ policy sparks global right-wing emulation
themes.blurb: Javier Milei's proposal to implement a U.S.-style government shutdown in Argentina has inspired right-wing leaders worldwide to consider similar fiscal policies. This trend reflects a broader push for austerity and reduced government spending among conservative and libertarian movements.

countries.note: Milei proposes a U.S.-style government shutdown to enforce fiscal discipline, sparking debates about austerity and state reform.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration officials and allies praise Milei's shutdown proposal, framing it as a model for fiscal responsibility.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox advocates for similar austerity measures in Spain, aligning with Milei's push for reduced government spending and fiscal reform.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing parties discuss adopting austerity policies inspired by Milei's shutdown proposal, emphasizing fiscal discipline.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD promotes Milei's shutdown policy as a solution to Germany's fiscal challenges, advocating for reduced government intervention.

signals: austerity as a political rallying cry

themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe

countries.note: Lega and Fratelli d'Italia push for stricter citizenship laws and automatic deportations for non-EU migrants convicted of crimes.

countries.note: Le Pen's party advocates for reduced immigration quotas and stricter integration policies, positioning immigration as a key electoral issue.
